name: DPM++ 2M SDE (Heun correction)
plain: The same code as 2M SDE with solver_type=heun, which changes the coefficient of the second-order correction. There is no second model call despite the name: still one call per step.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
Same as 2M SDE except correction: x'+=α'(((1−e^{−h_η})/(−h_η))+1)(1/r)(D−D_old).

props.flow_const: half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr: λ=−log σ normally, λ=log((1−σ)/σ) on CONST; α=σe^{λ} (1 normally, 1−σ on CONST). First σ≥1 on CONST replaced by percent_to_sigma(1e-4); s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Same algorithm; the _gpu name differs only by building the BrownianTreeNoiseSampler with cpu=False, so the noise tensor values differ for one seed.

label: from code
surprise: heun here names a correction coefficient only; no Heun-style second model call happens.
